text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...This day has finally arrived, hasn't 
it?
choice_data_list: Yeah. ...I'm mentally prepared.
Yeah. ...I'm ready for it.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Well then, shall we begin? Our 
meeting for the commemorative photo of our 
"Best Partner Award"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
――It all started back on the day we 
received word from Monthly Twinkle that we 
had been chosen for the Best Partners 
Award...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you so much for agreeing to be 
interviewed for our 'Best Partner Grand 
Prix' feature!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Your success on the Tiara route, and the 
way you face each race caring for one 
another! You truly deserve to be called a 
legendary duo!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...To share such an honor alongside you, 
Trainer... It is truly a privilege.
choice_data_list: I'm proud of it too...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...My excitement hasn't cooled down yet. 
To think the reporters recognized the bond 
between you and me...
choice_data_list: Shall we celebrate, just the two of us?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
You're right... I'd really love to take a 
commemorative photo with you, after all.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Just like how last year's winners took a 
photo together. ...We want to celebrate 
this bond, too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And having carved out a good chunk of free 
time, she began preparing for the 
photoshoot.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Meeting with the photographer, scouting 
shooting locations... Fufu♪ I can't afford 
to neglect any of it.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
A special opportunity like this doesn't 
come around often. ...I wonder what kind 
of photos they'll turn out to be.
choice_data_list:
(I can't believe you're looking forward to 
it this much...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I want to make this the best photo 
possible for her. That desire sprouts 
strongly within me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For example, what if we granted all of 
Cesario's wishes? That way, it would 
surely result in her ideal photo—
choice_data_list: (...No, but—)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
The path to the future that I walk upon. I 
want you to be right there beside me.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer?
choice_data_list:
...Yeah, let's make it the best photo 
together.

...Yeah, let's make it the best photo 
together.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, of course. After all, this is a 
commemorative photo of you and me.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
As for photo spots, how about choosing a 
place full of memories for us?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"...Though having so many wonderful 
memories makes it hard to choose, 
honestly."
choice_data_list:
If you want a nice view, that beach over 
there might be good.

If you want a nice view, that beach over 
there might be nice.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the coast where we watched the first 
sunrise together, right? Sounds great, 
it's truly lovely♪

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
The sunrise was so beautiful. ...I still 
remember it. Even though I ended up 
falling asleep in the passenger seat—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Wah, classic suits and elegant dresses... 
All the outfits are so wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
This is a special photo of us, after all. 
We have to dress in our finest, don't we?
choice_data_list:
If you don't mind, could you help me pick 
out some accessories?

If you don't mind, could you help me pick 
out some accessories together?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Me? I'm honored, but... This is a 
celebration for you as well, so you're 
free to dress up however you like, you 
know?"
choice_data_list:
I just felt like that would be more like 
us.

I just felt like that would be more like 
us.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, that might be true. After all, 
we've always made our decisions together.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
In that case... Ah, that white corsage. 
Would you like to try it on later?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
It's perfect for someone as sincere as 
you... I'm sure it'll suit you 
wonderfully♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Slowly and serenely, preparations for the 
commemorative photo continued... until 
finally—

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text:
Yes, both of your makeup looks perfect. 
Please wait just a little longer until we 
begin shooting!
choice_data_list: Y-Yes!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
We've finally reached this day. ...I am 
truly proud to stand here beside you.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Our preparations are absolutely flawless. 
I'm certain these photos will turn out to 
be true gems.
choice_data_list: ...Yeah, that's true.
...Yeah, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I feel the exact same way as Cesario. This 
commemorative photo is sure to become an 
unforgettable memory.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Because that is—
choice_data_list: It's because you stayed by my side.
It's because you stayed by my side

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ! ...Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That we spoke together, that we chose 
together. I am prouder of that than 
anything else.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because up until now, that's how we've 
always supported each other.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Through times of hardship and times of 
bliss. She was always by my side. ...And 
then—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I want to stay by her side forever from 
here on out.
choice_data_list: —Cesario.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, what is it?
choice_data_list:
I want you to keep walking toward the 
future with me.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, <username>-san.
choice_data_list:
That's precisely why we should take the 
best photos today!
It's bound to be a long journey.
It's bound to be a long journey, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, <username>-san.
choice_data_list:
That's precisely why we should take the 
best photos today!
It's bound to be a long journey.
It's bound to be a long journey, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course. I'm sure we can take a 
good one.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
A photo that, even years from now, we can 
look back on and smile together... That's 
what I want.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, indeed. But... this too is just 
another memory.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"One by one, from now on... I want to keep 
building memories together with you."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's true. ...However, we 
accomplished the preparations for this 
photo shoot together as well, didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Even if it takes time, we will surely 
reach our dream. ...As long as you are by 
my side."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes. In this Twinkle Series, and in the 
future beyond it as well. I want to run 
with everything I have.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"That is precisely why I need your 
support. ...Because you are my 
irreplaceable partner."
